_comment: Mutations that reintroduce the market-data coverage defects this branch fixed.
E1: the loader's records of WHAT it delivered were read by NOBODY outside
the archive module, so a backtest reported the KPIs of a shorter
window as the KPIs of the window that was asked for.  The coverage is
now delivered ON the KPI dict the run saves.
E2: the local cache was filed by a SECOND, hand-written copy of the venue
predicate, and the two copies disagreed: the 'coinm' alias was filed
under the SPOT folder while the REST path and the archive answered it
with COIN-M candles.
E3: ONE archive file that could not be fetched collapsed the whole budget,
so a single unlucky request destroyed a load that could have finished.
A TIMEOUT still collapses the budget (the host is not there); a RESET
does not (it is evidence about one request).
E5: the 451 body check accepted EITHER of Binance's phrases, so a proxy
whose body merely said 'restricted location' armed the archive.
E6: the coverage note blamed the ARCHIVE for every gap, including the
ones the archive never saw (a REST frame that starts late).
E7: the interior holes the archive records on the frame were dropped from
the note, so the note returned None and the KPI payload carried
nothing for a backtest whose only gap was a hole in the middle.
Run with:  python tools/mutation_harness.py tools/mutations/market_data_coverage_honesty.json
NEVER run concurrently with a test run or tools/review_fanout.py -- both will
read a file that is mid-mutation and report on code that does not exist.
NOT MUTATION-COVERED, ON PURPOSE: the celery task in tasks.py cannot be
imported without a live database (it raises at import time), so its
wiring is checked in the SOURCE by the test file and the function it
calls is covered by E1-A below.  A mutation of that one line would
SURVIVE, which is why it is not in this spec.

mutations.label: E1-A: the coverage is never put on the KPI dict the run saves
mutations.replace:
if isinstance(kpis, dict):
        pass  # MUTANT: the coverage is dropped

mutations.label: E1-B: the loader never reports what the frame actually covers
mutations.needle:
if trailing_short <= 0 and leading_gap <= 0 and not remote_failed:
        return None
mutations.replace:
if True:  # MUTANT: the coverage is never reported
        return None

mutations.label: E1-B2: the leading gap is not measured, so a truncated leading month is not reported
mutations.replace: leading_gap = 0.0  # MUTANT: the leading edge is never measured

mutations.label: E1-C: the portfolio backtest stops carrying the coverage
mutations.replace: pass  # MUTANT: the coverage is dropped

mutations.label: E2: the cache is filed by the hand-written venue predicate again
mutations.needle:
venue = config.resolve_market_venue(market_type)
    market_folder = "spot" if venue == "spot" else "futures"
mutations.replace: market_folder = "futures" if "futures" in market_type else "spot"  # MUTANT: a second venue predicate

mutations.label: E3-A: one lost request collapses the budget again
E3-B: a host that does not answer no longer ends the load fast
mutations.replace: if False and _is_host_not_answering(error):  # MUTANT: the timeout does not collapse

mutations.label: E3-C: the second file that cannot be fetched no longer ends the load
mutations.needle:
failures = _note_transport_failure(url)
                if failures >= _TRANSPORT_FAILURE_COLLAPSE_THRESHOLD:
                    _collapse_deadline()
                    raise
                logger.warning(
                    f"Bulk archive: the daily file {url} could not be fetched. "
mutations.replace:
failures = _note_transport_failure(url)
                logger.warning(
                    f"Bulk archive: the daily file {url} could not be fetched. "

mutations.label: E3-D: the file that could not be fetched is not recorded
E5: a 451 body that does not name Binance arms the archive again
mutations.replace: return "restricted location" in text.lower()  # MUTANT: the generic phrase is accepted as Binance's

mutations.label: E6: every gap is blamed on the archive again
mutations.replace: holder = "the archive"  # MUTANT: the archive is blamed for every gap

mutations.label: E7: the interior holes are dropped from the note again
mutations.replace: missing_buckets = []  # MUTANT: the interior holes are dropped again
